result:
Round 259 is planned and `b-next.json` says **CONTINUE**. I changed nothing in `store/`: HEAD is still `d732d26` and the tree is clean.

**Round 258 (regression sweep):** C ran every browser check it could, at both 1440×900 and 1280×720, with `browserVerified=true` and `realVerified=true`.
- 114 checks passed and the smoke test passed. The app's behaviour has not regressed.
- 5 checks stayed blocked because the backend is not available in the cloud.
- One Medium finding failed the round: **C-R258-01**. The performance test harness still waits for a "Pause" button label, removed in round 256, and for an old clip tooltip, changed in rounds 252–253. Because of that, the fader, drag and playback speed limits have not actually been measured since gate 225 (`80fbb3b`), including "no audio restart while dragging a fader during playback".
- The sweep ran in full, so `regression-last.json` is now 2026-10-30 / round 258. The next regression round is due on or after 2026-11-02.

**Round 259 (`current-task.md`): fix only the test harness.** Nothing in `app/` changes.
- **Code:** in `perf/lib/page.ts`, find the Play button by its constant name and detect playback from its `data-playing` attribute plus the existing "audio is really running" check. In the interactions spec, change the clip tooltip text to the current one.
- **Budget files:** only the explanatory `note` text changes. C checks that no limit or other field moves.
- **Docs:** the sections of implementation docs 163 and 168 that describe this signal, plus a new doc 194.
- **C checks:**
  - no old strings are left in `perf/`;
  - in the real browser at both viewports, Play goes `false` → `true` → `false` on two Space presses after adding a clip;
  - the full perf run, alone: 3/3 specs, no aborts, every limit met;
  - a comparison against the old baseline, report only;
  - the docs;
  - the sign-in guard.

**I tested the fix first on a scratch copy** (`/tmp/b259-scratch`), with results under `b-round-258/precheck/`:
- The perf suite passed 3/3 in 13.5 minutes, with no aborts.
- The fader checks pass on the published app: 0 audio restarts while dragging during playback, at most 1 component re-rendered per move, and 1 save on release.
- No other outdated selector turned up.
- I also ran C's browser recipe on the live server at both viewports, and it works.

**Two things to know:**
- **Re-render drift:** every interaction now re-renders 6–7 more React components than at gate 225 (for example 87 → 94 when playback starts). These are measured but have no limit, so this is not a bug. I recorded it as a performance signal (INFO-B259-COMPONENT-DRIFT) and will rule on it after round 259.
- **Cache write:** the scratch build used `store/node_modules` through a link, so build tools may have written cache files into `store/node_modules/.vite`. That folder is ignored by git and `git status` stayed empty.

**Order:** round 260 is the retrospective (due every 15 rounds; it will analyse this miss), round 261 is SABA-B-9 stage 2 (master volume to the bottom-right), then SABA-B-11c.

**Other files updated:**
- `tasks/round-258.md`: an exact copy of the old task.
- `backlog.json`: decisions D-29z507…514, the C-R258-01 finding, corrections for the next regression round's checklist, and the idea of having the harness use the app's own strings, saved for the retrospective.
- `feature-status.md`: the perf harness is marked as a bug, with the fader evidence flagged as out of date until round 259.
- `lessons.md`: two existing lessons now also say to search `perf/` when a label or tooltip is renamed (still 59 lines).
- `b-round-258.md`: my reasoning.

**Consults:** the advisor was available and I used it twice. The second review caught that C's browser check would have failed, because Space does nothing in an empty project; I fixed the recipe and tested it. I consulted no project agents, because this is a test-only round with no new feature behaviour. No new answers from Saba have arrived; SABA-B-7 is still waiting on him.

**Not COMPLETE:** C-R258-01 is open, and the remaining transport/grid stages, performance work, store redesign, approved review recommendations, advanced T12 work, phase 2 and the deferred Lows remain. **Not BLOCKED:** round 259 can run in the cloud.
